hero.heading: Your next visit, already prepared.
hero.subheading: Tell your story once — from your phone, in minutes. Acute Insight AI turns it into a clinical brief your provider reviews before your visit, so your appointment starts at the conversation that matters.

conditions.heading: Built for the concerns that fill real clinics.
conditions.subheading: The adaptive intake handles everyday complaints, chronic condition check-ins, and mental health concerns. Emergency-level symptoms are flagged immediately with guidance to call 911 or go to the ER.

items.title: No clipboard, no repetition
items.body: Complete your intake from your phone, couch, or office before you ever set foot in the clinic. Your provider gets your full story without you filling out the same form again.

items.title: AI intake that actually listens
items.body: Our adaptive assistant asks follow-up questions based on your answers — not a generic form. Your provider receives a structured clinical brief built from what you actually said.

items.title: Built by a practicing physician
items.body: Acute Insight AI was designed by a hospitalist who lives the intake problem every day. The questions, the flags, and the provider brief are shaped by real clinical work — not a product committee.

items.title: Emergency-aware by design
items.body: A safety layer screens every answer for emergency-level symptoms. If something sounds dangerous, you're told immediately to call 911 or get to an ER — before anything else.

items.title: Your health history, always with you
items.body: Your profile stores your medications, allergies, and chronic conditions. Every intake builds on the last — no repeating yourself.

items.title: Private to you and your care team
items.body: Your health data is encrypted in transit, visible only to you and your provider, and never sold or shared. Full HIPAA-grade infrastructure is on our checklist before general availability.

howItWorks.heading: From symptoms to an informed visit in three steps

steps.title: Create your account
steps.body: Sign up in under a minute. Add your health profile — medications, allergies, chronic conditions — so your provider has the full picture from the start.

steps.title: Complete your AI intake
steps.body: Describe what's going on through an adaptive questionnaire or a natural conversation. It takes minutes and asks the right follow-up questions based on what you tell it.

steps.title: Your provider walks in prepared
steps.body: Your clinician reviews your AI-structured brief — chief complaint, history, medications, and flagged concerns — before your visit begins.

cost.heading: Free for patients during the clinical beta.
cost.body: Acute Insight AI is currently in clinical beta with participating providers. There is no charge to patients for completing an intake, nothing is billed to insurance, and there are no hidden fees — your medical visit itself remains between you and your provider as it always has.

privacy.heading: Your health data belongs to you
privacy.body: Built by a physician who handles protected health information every day. Your information is encrypted in transit, visible only to you and your care team, and never sold, shared, or used for advertising — ever. Before general availability, we're completing the full set of HIPAA safeguards: encryption at rest, audit logging, and signed BAAs across our infrastructure. You can request an export or deletion of your data at any time.

items.question: What exactly does Acute Insight AI do?
items.answer: It's an intelligent pre-visit intake. You describe what's going on — by tapping through adaptive questions or chatting naturally with the AI assistant — and your provider receives a structured clinical summary with flagged concerns before your visit. It does not diagnose, treat, or prescribe.

items.question: Does the AI give me medical advice?
items.answer: No. The assistant gathers and organizes your history for your clinician. Diagnosis and treatment decisions stay with your provider. The one exception: if your answers suggest an emergency, it will tell you immediately to call 911 or go to the ER.

items.question: What happens after I submit my intake?
items.answer: Your responses are structured into a clinical brief — chief complaint, history, severity, medications, allergies, and flagged considerations — that appears in your provider's dashboard for review before your appointment.

items.question: What if my symptoms are an emergency?
items.answer: The intake screens every answer for emergency-level symptoms. If something sounds dangerous — chest pain, trouble breathing, stroke signs, thoughts of self-harm — you're immediately shown guidance to call 911 or go to the nearest ER. Online intake is never a substitute for emergency care.

items.question: Is my information private?
items.answer: Your health data is encrypted in transit, visible only to you and your care team, and never sold or shared. We're in clinical beta: before general availability, we're completing the full set of HIPAA safeguards, including encryption at rest, audit logging, and BAAs across our infrastructure. You can request export or deletion of your data at any time.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Nothing, for patients, during the clinical beta. Nothing is billed to insurance — your visit itself remains between you and your provider as it always has.
